text:
Tom Ortega: Heads-up: we're releasing the Q2 Inference Benchmarks + partner case study tomorrow 9am PT. Need a lean launch plan and a quick decision on whether to include raw graphs in the public appendix.
Lila Singh: I can own owned channels and the community thread. Will need final headline + shortlink by 5am PT.
Markus Vogel: I'll prepare the partner quote approvals and coordinate the joint webinar invite list. Partner asks for embargo until noon PT. Can we align?
Priya Nair: Press: small list of beat reporters + one trade. I'll craft a short embargoed pitch. Question: do we send full appendix with raw graphs or a summarized PDF? Legal wants checks.
LegalBot: Recommendation: publish summarized charts with methodology appendix. Raw cluster logs or per-run traces = internal only. Any public metric must cite "internal benchmark results" and have sign-off. Legal sign-off required by 2 hours before publish.
Tom Ortega: Okay summarized charts only. We'll surface raw data in partner-only packet under an access agreement. Markus, can you secure that?
Markus Vogel: Yes, will ask partner to sign the partner data access form. ETA: 2 hours.
Jena (publish-bot): Scheduled publish job set for 2026-07-02 16:00:00 UTC (9:00 AM PT). Draft URL: https://blog.redwood.inference/q2-benchmarks (placeholder).
Lila Singh: Social plan: 1 hero tweet, 1 carousel post for LinkedIn, 1 community thread linking to methodology. Need copy and image.
Design Bot: Can produce hero stat card + methodology thumbnail by 4:00 AM PT if copy is frozen. Need final stat line (conservative).
Tom Ortega: Use conservative stat language: "up to 22% median latency reduction in our internal tests" and note hardware and config in the appendix.
Priya Nair: Draft embargo pitch: "Hi {reporter}, we're embargoing Q2 Inference Benchmarks + partner story. Highlights: up to 22% median latency reduction in internal tests; partner saw X cost reduction. Want an embargoed copy?" Feedback?
LegalBot: Include phrase "based on internal benchmark results" and add embargo code EMB-Q2-BENCH-0702. Also confirm partner permissions for quoted numbers.
Markus Vogel: Partner confirms cost reduction metric but asks we round to "~20%" publicly. I'll confirm exact phrasing.
Lila Singh: Good catch. We'll use "up to 22%" for internal docs and "~20%" in public social cards. Design, please prepare two stat variants.
Design Bot: Noted. Will output one card with "~20%" badge and one detailed chart for the blog appendix.
Tom Ortega: CTA on posts: "Read the report & see reproducible methodology" -> link with UTMs: utm_source=owned, utm_campaign=q2_bench, utm_medium={channel}.
Priya Nair: Press plan: send embargoed kit 24 hours before lift, embargo lift at 2026-07-02 16:00:00 UTC. I'll own outreach and follow-ups.
Lila Singh: I'll draft tweet variants and a short LinkedIn carousel. Posting cadence: hero tweet at T+0, thread with highlights at T+10m, LinkedIn at T+30m.
Jena (publish-bot): After publish, I will auto-post to #announcements and #company-blog. Ensure channel copy is ready.
Tom Ortega: Webinar: partner wants a 30-min joint webinar next week. Markus, please collect 3-4 proposed times and we'll publish the sign-up link in the post.
Markus Vogel: Will do. Also prepping a 1-paragraph partner blurb for the press kit.
LegalBot: Reminder: any partner quotes used publicly must have explicit written permission in the press kit. 
Priya Nair: I'll request signed approval from partner by EOD. If not approved, we'll remove partner name and use anonymized case study.
Lila Singh: Draft tweets (short):
- Variant A: New Q2 Inference Benchmarks: up to ~20% median latency reduction in our internal tests. Deep-dive + methodology: https://blog.redwood.inference/q2-benchmarks?utm_source=twitter&utm_campaign=q2_bench&utm_medium=tweet
- Variant B (thread opener): Q2 Benchmarks: cost & latency tradeoffs for production inference. Highlights, methodology, and partner case study inside. [link]
Tom Ortega: Good. Final approvals needed: Product + Legal sign-off by 6:00 AM PT. Design assets by 4:00 AM PT. Press kit + embargo sends by 16:00 PT previous day.
Markus Vogel: Partner approval in progress. Will update in thread.
Jena (publish-bot): Reminder scheduled publish time again: 2026-07-02 16:00:00 UTC. I will post to #announcements and #company-blog at publish.
Priya Nair: I'll post the embargoed pitch drafts here for quick review in the next hour.
Tom Ortega: Thanks team  keep blockers in this thread. If partner delays, we have fallback copy that anonymizes the case study. :sparkles:
